header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Shoukat Islam Kunbhar, advocate for the petitioner
body: 4. The grievance of the petitioner is only that his application filed before the respondent No.1 i.e the Assistant Commissioner (Revenue), Taluka Hussain Bux Mari, Mirpurkhas, is pending since 2023 and not being decided.

Learned A.A.G available in other matters waived of the notice of this petition and submitted that he has no objection if directions are issued to Respondent No.1 to decide the petitioner's pending application within the shortest period of time.

In view of the above circumstances, this petition is disposed of with directions to Respondent No. 1 to decide the petitioner's pending application, if any, within a period of thirty (30) days from the date of receipt of this order.
Copy of this order be communicated to Respondent No. 1 and the Deputy Commissioner, Mirpurkhas, for information and compliance. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
